title: Claude API Pricing 2026: Rates for Every Model
summary: Claude API pricing charges per million tokens with separate input and output rates by model. See costs for direct use and integration tools.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Answered from Anthropic's own pages as checked on 2026-10-24, these are the points the pricing sections leave open.


### Is the Claude API free to try?


Not reliably. Whether a new Console account gets starter credit has changed over time, so treat it as a bonus rather than a budget line. Check the billing page in the Anthropic Console to see what your account holds.


On a free or low-deposit account you start at the entry tier, which Anthropic's rate limits documentation describes. A trial that runs into that ceiling will look slower than production would.


Does a Claude Pro subscription include API access? No. Anthropic's help center treats the Claude apps and the API as separate products with separate billing.


A Pro subscription pays for chat use, and Anthropic meters API calls per token against a Console account.


If you are pricing a workload, ignore the subscription fee entirely. It doesn't offset any of your token spend.


### Why did my Claude API bill exceed my estimate?


Usually because the estimate counted visible text and the meter counts more. Anthropic's extended thinking documentation says thinking tokens bill as output tokens, and output is the more expensive side of the price list.


Writing to the cache costs more than a plain input token, according to Anthropic's prompt caching documentation, so **a cache that's rarely re-read loses money** .


Then there is input you never typed: tool definitions, system prompts and retries. Compare the usage figures returned with each response against your estimate to see which of these is responsible.


### How do I get higher Claude API rate limits?


To raise your limits, move up a tier. The rate limits page in Anthropic's documentation lists what each tier requires, typically a cumulative deposit or spend. Higher tiers raise request and token ceilings per model.


For needs beyond the published tiers, that page points to contacting Anthropic's sales team about custom limits. Plan the request early, because tier advancement isn't instant and your queue will absorb the wait as latency.


### Do Claude API prices change without notice?


Treat the numbers as dated, not fixed. Anthropic's pricing page is the single source of current rates, and it can change between your estimate and your invoice.


When a model is retired, your unit cost changes even if list prices stand still.


Anthropic announces model retirements separately on the deprecations page in the documentation, and moving off a retired model is what shifts the cost. Record the date next to every price you use, and re-check both pages before you commit to a budget.
